caption:
Part 4. The call came again. This time to her own cell. 📱

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: June learned the Larkspur Road call has come every Christmas Eve since 1952, and the caller is the man who answered the first one.
scenes.image: an old black and white photo of a young dispatcher lying on a basement table

scenes.narration: June slept through Christmas Day. When she woke up it was dark, and the tree in her window was the only light on the street.
scenes.image: a small house on a snowy street at night, one Christmas tree glowing in a window

scenes.narration: At 11:52, her phone buzzed. Her personal cell. The caller wasn't blocked. It was blank.
scenes.image: smartphone vibrating on a nightstand in a dark bedroom, its screen glowing faintly

scenes.narration: She knew she shouldn't. She answered anyway.
scenes.image: a woman sitting up in bed holding a glowing phone to her ear

scenes.narration: Walter's voice. Gentler now. June, he said. They're singing outside again. But not outside my house.
scenes.image: close-up of a woman's face in phone glow, breath held

scenes.narration: She went to her window. Snow blowing sideways. And on her front lawn, standing in a circle, were twelve people in long dark coats.
scenes.image: twelve figures in long dark coats standing in a circle on a snowy front lawn, seen through a window

scenes.narration: Their mouths were open. Their breath didn't fog. They were singing the first verse. She knew it was the first, because now she knew them all.
scenes.image: close view of dark silhouettes in the snow, faces hidden, standing perfectly still

scenes.narration: Walter said: last night you stayed on to the very end. Nobody stays to the end. That's how they choose. They pick the one who listens.
scenes.image: woman pressed against a cold window, phone at her ear, snow beyond the glass

scenes.narration: June asked what they want. Walter said: a voice. Someone to make the call. Someone to warn whoever answers.
scenes.image: an old man's silhouette sitting in an armchair by a dark window, a rotary phone in his lap

scenes.narration: Then the singing stopped mid-word. And all twelve of them turned, at the same moment, and looked up at her window.
scenes.image: twelve dark figures in the snow all turning their heads toward a lit upstairs window
